newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's East Asiatic restructures. [CORRECTED 10:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Denmark's East Asiatic restructures. [CORRECTED 10:50 GMT]

text.p: Danish shipping and wholesale group East Asiatic Company said on Friday that it had liquidated its holding company as part of a streamlining of the group structure.

"The most important result of the liquidation is that shareholders will have their stock in the East Asiatic Company's Holding Company exchanged for shares in the East Asiatic Company A/S at a ratio of one to one," a company statement said.

The holding company's closing account showed a pre-tax profit over the period May 31-September 19, 1996 of 162,000 crowns (corrects from millions to thousands of crowns). --Uffe Hansen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969658
